prompt: The idea for the framework came out of a conversation we had in September, I have the email chain. By February it was in his keynote with different words and his name. I have started keeping records of everything, timestamps, drafts, correspondence, because I don't know what else to do with the feeling that I am being slowly erased by someone who will write me a reference letter.
